thesis: The hosts introduce the story of Microsoft, focusing on its origins in the PC era and the backgrounds of Bill Gates and his family. They describe Bill Gates Sr. as a prominent attorney and angel investor who galvanized the Seattle entrepreneurial community, while his wife Mary Gates is characterized as a powerful business figure who served on numerous corporate and nonprofit boards without ever working full-time in a corporate setting.
